text: Value in the AI-to-AI economy compounds endogenously because agents reinvest their own outputs, that is new models, improved code and refined datasets, back into the network, creating self reinforcing growth loops that require no exogenous injection of scarce land, labor or physical capital.
citation: Wulf A. Kaal, The AI-to-AI Economy and the Collapse of Anthropocentric Economic Theory (2025). SSRN: https://ssrn.com/abstract=5886442

isBasedOn.name: The AI-to-AI Economy and the Collapse of Anthropocentric Economic Theory

abstract: More radically, value in the AI2AI economy compounds endogenously: agents reinvest their own outputs (new models, improved code, refined datasets) back into the network, creating self-reinforcing growth loops that require no exogenous injection of scarce land, labor, or physical capital
